purpose: Repeatable synthetic fixtures for P0 v2 event handling, metric calculations, privacy, negative testing, and AI grounding.
fixture_schema_status: Proposed fixture schema only. Production event/API mapping and metric definitions require approval.
expected_answers_scope: Two-session internal oracle only; full-dataset expectations are checked by validate_full_dataset.py.

privacy.full_fixture: Threshold eligibility and authorized reporting require separate verification.
privacy.warning: Repeated synthetic sessions do not establish real independent users or production privacy compliance.

not_for: claiming production dashboard or assistant behavior is validated
treating proposed event/API fields as approved production contracts
claiming AI evaluation cases have passed

Jeffin and Zhiliang: event/API field mapping
Harshita: actual UI success and failure behavior

source_revisions.note: The exact preparation-guide and event taxonomy revisions used to construct these fixtures have not been verified. Dataset and fixture schema versions are documented separately.

observation_window.scope: Synthetic event timestamp range, not a production reporting window

dish_revision_note: Fictional documentation placeholders only; dish revision IDs are not present in event records and are not production identifiers.

initial_saved_state.replicated_sessions: Each replicated session inherits the empty initial Saved state.

session_completion_policy.engagement_rule: A visit qualifies through at least 10 seconds of active visible dish-opening time OR a displayed Start/Replace comparison linked to a previously opened dish in the same session.
session_completion_policy.session_completion: No completed or unfinished order-session classification is supported because no order or checkout signal exists.
session_completion_policy.browse_only: Menu-only browsing is browse-only, not a failed session.
session_completion_policy.existing_fixture_limitation: Final saved-state assertions describe the end of the synthetic fixture, not verified order completion or causal conversion.
session_completion_policy.observed_save_retention: Descriptive proportion of visits that directly saved a dish and still have it saved at the end of the observed visit. Not finalized checkout retention. A zero denominator produces null.
session_completion_policy.inactivity_rule: A gap of 30 minutes or more ends the current visit. Inactivity does not establish order or checkout completion.
session_completion_policy.save_only: Save alone does not establish engagement.
